retained_attempts: Initial counter writer rejected an overly strict drawing-bounds equality; the corrected writer requires containment in the declared die.
Initial counter fault harness selected a finished artifact instead of the mapped netlist; the corrected harness retains the failed attempt and injects the actual mapped logic.

All four larger first attempts reached the original 600-second strict-LVS command timeout. Final attempts permit 3600 seconds without changing clock, electrical limits, RTL, geometry or verification flags.

Initial readback-harness checks incorrectly applied the finish identity to every stage and required identical cross-OS GDS polygon ordering. The final audit verifies each actual stage identity, every written mask and every represented fill square; original exported bytes retain their captured hashes. These diagnostic failures remain in the archived logs.
The first full unit-suite run encountered an unrelated transient Windows directory-rename error; its targeted retry and the full 1657-test rerun passed.
limitations: Reference block acceptance only. The supplemental written-layout checker still reports checks_passed_coverage_incomplete; its 104 passing checks do not constitute complete manual-rule or foundry qualification.

DCF.1a empty-field/local-COMP interpretation outside the declared core, complete-chip prime/scribe/frame boundaries, pad/RF and memory geometry, exclusion-edge tie/fill rows and foundry limits for clipped/local metal-density windows remain unqualified. No legal 5 um dummy COMP site exists inside these reference cores under the checked circuit clearances; that is not a general margin waiver.

Typical C 9K and D 11K interconnect only, with three captured Liberty conditions and coupling factor 1.0. Exact equality to the independently audited finite-R networks binds the prior 25-frequency comparison and resistance-fault controls; extractor field accuracy, additional RC corners and general signal integrity remain chunk-8 work.
Separate full-transistor RC waveform experiments are unfinished and do not inherit a pass from static timing or equivalence.
No full-device-family, larger mixed-signal, chip/package, consumer-package, foundry or public-release acceptance is asserted. SKY130 and IHP geometry/fill gates are unchanged.
